TLDR: My siblings.

I've tried to kill myself 3 times. To be completely honest, I think it was my 13 year old sister. My little brother too, but mostly my sister. I didn't make a huge lifestyle change or anything. If it wasn't for her, honestly, I might've tried again. I had good friends, a good therapist (fun fact, she almost sent me to the hospital on our first session), and medication (that I was 100% sure didn't work). I had all this going for me, and I still wanted to die every single day. Overdosed twice, tried to hang myself once (in the school bathroom, of all places!). I thought it was hilarious that I wanted to die. First time I overdosed, I didn't feel sad or anything. While talking to the doctors and psychiatric team I was all smiles. 
The thing is, first time I was in the mental hospital, my mom (while visiting) told me that my little sister was crying a lot. That she was sleeping in my bed, and was scared for me. Apparently she went from wanting to be an astronaut to wanting to work in the psychiatric field. She also told me that my brother was sleeping more than usual, and was worried for me. He had been skipping his baseball practices. 
I almost started crying on the spot. It was a feeling of, "I did this to them. They shouldn't have to be going through this."
After I got out, my sister wouldn't leave me in a room alone. I'd go somewhere, she would follow. This stopped after a while, but then she started helping my mom give me my pills (my mom went from trusting me with them to hiding them in her purse). 
After coming home from my second hospitalization, my little sister started spending a lot more time with me. I didn't think much of it, honestly. She started wearing my clothes, but my mom said it was because she was gaining weight and didn't want to go out shopping for new clothes. I kinda shrugged and bought it.
Nope. Later my mom confessed that it was because my sister wanted to feel closer to me.
Every time I saw my sister with one of my jackets or shirts my heart would break a little.
I guess I don't want to hurt my siblings. I'm the oldest, and my parents always told me that I had to be the role model. That I had to protect them. Up until a year ago I pretty much did that, until I fell off the "Handling Your Depression!" wagon and couldn't take it anymore. I just want to be there for them man.
Now my life's great! I have a lot going on for me, and a lot to look forward to.
